enunciado: Create Employee (name, salary) with totalSalary() and describe(). Create Manager which extends Employee, adds a bonus and overrides totalSalary() adding the bonus. Show both.
objetivos: Inherit attributes and methods with extends
Call the parent constructor with super(...)
Reuse the parent's method with super.method()
pistas: A Manager IS-AN Employee: it has everything an employee has.
The first statement of the child constructor must be super(...).
super.totalSalary() + this.bonus avoids repeating the computation.
